prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most specific kinds of change, as only 'home, wait_info', 'finish, new_screen', 'adoption, notification', 'sign_in, incentive', and 'choose_path, copy' have been tested at least twice.
'home, wait_info' is helpful, supported by three winning tests out of four (+3.1% average after noise correction).
'finish, new_screen' is helpful overall, with two winning tests out of three (+3.9% average after noise correction).
No clear effect was seen for both 'adoption, notification' and 'sign_in, incentive', as all tests for these kinds resulted in no clear effect.
Results for 'choose_path, copy' remain inconsistent across tests (one lost: worse, one won), so no clear pattern has been established.
Predictions were generally too high for unhelpful changes, but underpredicted gains on several winning tests (such as in 'home, wait_info' and 'choose_path, copy').

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Placement Verification Status: Display live desktop rendering and display layer readiness status updates on the waiting screen while the pet is prepared. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on the desktop, and home waiting step takes a long mean time (2336s). Previous tests show 'home, wait_info' is highly effective (+3.1% average gain).)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Command Test Drive Screen: Add an interactive command practice screen right before home_intro where users test showing, hiding, and dragging their pet. (why: Support received multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets. Lessons show 'finish, new_screen' changes consistently boost conversion (+3.9% average gain).)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign In After Adoption Flow: Reorder the onboarding flow so account sign-in occurs after pet adoption selection instead of before. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (60.9%). Letting users select or generate their pet first creates emotional investment before asking for sign-in.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Photo Upload Quality Check Screen: Insert an automated image lighting and contrast verification screen immediately following photo upload. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output. Catching bad uploads early improves adoption funnel completion (currently 60.9%).)
4: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Interactive Path Discovery Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a story scroll layout showcasing animated pet behavior side-by-side with selection paths. (why: Choose path exhibits a huge mean time (514s) relative to median (8s), indicating high variance and user hesitation. A story scroll layout visually communicates path differences faster.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Previous Account Pet Restoration Notice: Display a explicit hint on sign_in clarifying that signing into an existing account automatically restores existing pets. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again. Clear upfront messaging reduces drop-off from confused returning users.)
6: [home, wait_info] GPU & Engine Diagnostics Progress Tracker: Add a diagnostic progress checklist component to the waiting screen showing system compatibility checks in real time. (why: Support received tickets regarding app stalling or pet not appearing on desktop, and 'home, wait_info' is a proven winner in previous iterations (+3.1% avg gain).)
7: [adoption, layout] Split Layout Adoption Certificate Review: Reframe the adoption certificate screen using a split layout separating document preview from pet naming inputs. (why: Adoption conversion is the bottleneck at 60.9%. A split visual structure clarifies required actions vs confirmation details.)
8: [choose_path, copy] Action-Oriented Path Selection Copy: Update choose_path headline and body to contrast instant desktop companion start against deep custom AI creation. (why: The mean time on choose_path (514s) indicates user confusion during path choice. Clear action-focused contrast speeds up decision making.)
